versions.changelog:
Initial release of Web Artifact Studio skill.

- Provides an interactive web artifact creation tool supporting dashboards, form workflows, single-page apps, and interactive demos.
- Built-in support for React 18, shadcn/ui component library, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for responsive, accessible UI.
- Offers guidance and templates for data dashboard artifacts, multi-step form workflows, and single-file builds.
- Includes recommended project structure, best engineering practices, error handling tips, and design principles.
- Targeted at rapid prototyping, data visualization, and internal tool development—not for full-scale or back-end heavy applications.
